title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a scorching show with a hot first set, a fiery Scarlet‑Fire opening second set, and an electrifying Truckin' > Other One > Stella Blue > Sugar Magnolia close.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the energy of this performance – from the blazing opener on Shakedown Street through the rare Diamond Blues and the incendiary Scarlet‑Fire sequence that kicks off set two, to a closing medley of Truckin', The Other One, Stella Blue and Sugar Magnolia that had the crowd on fire.  The board copy is described as fantastic and crystal‑clear, making the show an outstanding addition to any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, highly positive reviews (4 and 5 stars) praise both performance energy and board‑recording quality, indicating a strong show with excellent sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Board copy described as fantastic and crystal‑clear; no technical complaints noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A hot, tight first set followed by a fiery second‑set opener and an exceptionally energetic closing sequence; flow praised throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's intro into The Other One was electrifying and shook the venue.
